proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ x y a b hw hy
  have hb : ∀ v : H, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ‖innerSL 𝕜 (x n) v‖ ≤ C := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hw v).norm.isBoundedUnder_le.bddAbove_range
    exact ⟨C, fun n => hC ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := banach_steinhaus hb
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => inner 𝕜 (x n) (y n - b)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun n => M * ‖y n - b‖)
    · intro n
      exact ((innerSL 𝕜 (x n)).le_opNorm _).trans (by gcongr; exact hM n)
    · have := ((hy.sub_const b).norm).const_mul M
      simpa using this
  have h2 := h1.add (hw b)
  simp only [zero_add] at h2
  refine h2.congr fun n => ?_
  rw [inner_sub_right]; ring
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (x y : ℕ → H) (a b : H), (∀ v, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => inner 𝕜 (x n) v) Filter.atTop (nhds (inner 𝕜 a v))) → Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => inner 𝕜 (x n) (y n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (inner 𝕜 a b))
